calls.title: GrowthBook x Legend
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the integration of event attributes into Adobe Analytics via the GrowthBook SDK, emphasizing the current data setup that includes visitor ID, location, and device type for enriched experimentation analysis. Chris Sanders explained the query structure feeding from Snowflake, emphasizing metrics built on fact tables for user-friendly KPI analysis without requiring SQL skills. The team discussed feature flag tracking, advocating for precision in evaluating user exposure to avoid misleading data. Data slicing methods and future queries were outlined, and the focus remains on data accuracy and completing Adobe integration. Coordination efforts between North America and UK teams were also emphasized, as well as the importance of effective communication despite time zone challenges.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Adobe integration, experiment assignment, SDK attributes, metric slicing, feature flag evaluation
